title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description: Designs and delivers scalable client-facing web applications, robust backend microservices, database schemas, and automated CI pipelines.
typical_requirements: Proficiency with modern JavaScript/TypeScript and React frontend ecosystems.
Hands-on experience building asynchronous RESTful APIs using Python or Node.js.
Solid understanding of relational database schema design, indexing, and SQL queries.
Experience with Git workflow, unit testing, and containerization using Docker.

title: Backend Systems Engineer
description: Architects low-latency server-side systems, manages database transactions, optimizes API throughput, and ensures system reliability.
typical_requirements: Extensive experience developing high-performance REST APIs with Python or Go.
Deep understanding of database optimization, transaction isolation, and caching strategies.
Proven capability deploying Docker container services and building scalable architectures.

title: Frontend Engineer (React / TypeScript)
description: Crafts beautiful, responsive, and accessible user interfaces with clean state management and modular design systems.
typical_requirements: Mastery of modern React hooks, component lifecycle, and state management.
Strict typing discipline with TypeScript and rapid styling using Tailwind CSS.
Deep knowledge of responsive design, browser performance optimization, and RESTful API consumption.

title: AI / ML Applications Engineer
description: Bridges machine learning models with production backend services, vector search systems, and automated data pipelines.
typical_requirements: Solid foundation in machine learning, NLP, and vector embeddings using Sentence Transformers.
Experience deploying ML inference pipelines behind FastAPI or Flask endpoints.
Familiarity with data manipulation, vector databases, and evaluation metrics.
